source_row.society: British Association for the Study of the Liver
source_row.extraction_instructions:
Bespoke ColdFusion (index.cfm), server-rendered. eid/999 ('All Events') lists BASL, endorsed and other societies' events on ONE page:

November 2026

month headings (the date cells carry no year) followed by div.eventItemArea blocks with a date cell ('06 / Nov', '20 Nov - 21 Nov'), the title and the full write-up in a collapsed div#eventContentNNN - there are no per-event detail pages. Each shell's booking_url is the listing URL + #eventContentNNN; extract_detail parses the stashed write-up (Venue/Location/Date/Time lines, prose fees, registration link -> organiser_url). Status suffixes ('- Registration now open', '- Save the Date') are stripped; 'Postponed' / cancelled items are skipped.

registry_comment: BASL events: ColdFusion single-page list (eid/999) with month headings and inline write-ups, fragment booking URLs, prose fee parsing

concerns: No per-event URL exists: booking_url is '<listing>#eventContentNNN'. The id is the CMS record id (stable); if BASL ever renumbers, rows would be re-created. All events share one page, so coverage_checks reads page-wide links and prints PRICE_EXTERNAL_LINK for every fee-less event (zoom / execbs.eventsair.com registration links, not fee tables).

Coverage checklist: #1 ranges from the date cell and a 'Date:' line; #2/#5 registration is on execbs.eventsair.com (JavaScript app, fees not read; kept as organiser_url) and Zoom registration for webinars - events whose write-up states no fee have pricing_tiers = []; #3 none; #4 n/a; #6 the Basic Science Retreat mentions abstracts (left to the pipeline merge step).

eid/999 includes endorsed and third-party items (e.g. BSG HPB Trainee Symposium); they are kept as BASL lists them. Items marked Postponed (BASL/BSG Research Webinar 12 Nov) have no date and are skipped.

The Palliative Hepatology SIG meeting offers in-person plus virtual registration, stored as hybrid. 'Meeting Times: 09:30-10:00 - Registration' puts start_time at the registration time for the Introduction to Hepatology meeting.
Members-only fees: BASL prints member and non-member rates publicly; nothing is behind a login.

Text-LLM chain on 2026-10-21: nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b and meta/muse-glimmer-30b both answered 404 'gone', so the harness descriptions/specialties came from openai/gpt-oss-20b. Descriptions and specialty have deterministic backstops (first real paragraph; per-society default specialty), so extraction does not depend on the LLM. The probe_models job will go red until the chain is rotated.

specialty_classifier.classify_specialty is deliberately NOT used as the backstop: on single-specialty societies it returned wrong labels (Cardiology/Oncology/GP Training for hepatology webinars). The backstop is the society's own specialty constant when the LLM returns None.

Shared-helper wishes (not changed, per rules): pricing_tables.parse_pricing_tables keeps only the LAST price column when the header names are not timeframes (BSSH Scientific Meeting 'Full meeting | One day' lost the full-meeting rates), drops the category column of [Ticket | Category | Price] tables (BAUS), and can take a nearby sentence as the section name ('Registration fees do not include'). Each extractor carries a small local table helper instead (matrix_tiers / ticket_tiers / rowspan_tiers / external_fee_hop, duplicated inline per file).
coverage_checks SINGLE_DAY_SUSPECT / PRICE_TEXT_ON_PAGE warnings that remain in the harness are explained per source below; none is a missed fee or date on the event's own page.

2026-10-22 audit: the 'more' control on the BASL list is vestigial for listing. Each event's 'more' link is a Bootstrap collapse toggle that only expands that event's write-up (the only script is a click handler swapping the link text more/less); the full list is already in the HTML. eid/999 holds 11 event blocks (10 upcoming, 1 past), and ?page=2, /page/2 and /startrow/11 return byte-identical pages (59037 bytes, same 11 blocks), so there is no hidden pagination or load-more request. Shell count stays 10.
